The '''''Terror of Tenoo''''' was a [[cruiser]] operated by the [[pirate]] [[Blackbolt]] during the [[High Republic Era]].<ref name="Terror" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Terror of Tenoo first appeared in the episode "[[The Terror of Tenoo]]" from the [[Young Jedi Adventures Season Two|second season]] of the animated series [[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]].<ref name="Terror" /> The bridge of the ship is modeled by [[Baptiste Tomorszki]].<ref>{{ArtStation|username=baptistetomorszki|url=artwork/3EEg42|name=Baptiste Tomorszki|text=Young Jedi Adventures - Season 2 Ep 05 - Bridge Terror of Tenoo - Environment Modeling}}</ref>
